## Checklist

- [ ] Conventional commit messages (`feat:`, `fix:`, `docs:`, `chore:`, ...)
- [ ] Commits are signed off for the DCO (`git commit -s`) — CI enforces this
- [ ] Tests and the gate chain pass locally (`./scripts/bootstrap.sh`, then `git commit`)
- [ ] Docs updated if behavior, interfaces, or gates changed
- [ ] For a non-trivial change: an ADR under `docs/decisions/` (constitution Article II)
- [ ] Scope respected — not re-opening a decision recorded in `FUTURE.md`
